home_tagline: Paste or build your Pokémon Champions team and get the official Play! Pokémon team list as a ready-to-print PDF.
footer_disclaimer: PokeListo is a fan-made tool and is not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures or The Pokémon Company.
pdf_instruction_staff: Complete both pages of this document. Submit this page to event staff before the tournament, at the time set by the Organizer.
pdf_instruction_opponents: Do not lose this page! Keep it throughout the tournament, sharing it with your opponent each round.
pdf_footer: All Pokémon must be listed exactly as they appear in the Battle Team.
